en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined open field or park with a tall Gothic‑style church featuring a very slender spire and clock tower in the center background. Another smaller spire is visible to the right. In the foreground are trees and a few people walking near the edge of the field. The image has a printed caption at the lower left and a small logo and number at the lower right.
